name: tehnadzor
description: Tehnadzor is a proprietary web application for construction supervision, QA/QC workflows, and BIM/IFC-based inspection records.

scripts.build:client:core: npm run build:index-html && tsc -p ./tsconfig.client.json && node ./scripts/build/inject-firebase-config.mjs && node ./scripts/build/postbuild-client.mjs
scripts.build:client: npm run build:client:core && npm run build:bim-viewer && npm run stamp:sw-cache
scripts.build:ts: npm run build:client && npm run build:server:ts && npm run build:functions:ts
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ts && npm run build:profile-feed && npm run build:hosting && npm run check:hosting
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:client && npm run build:demo && node ./scripts/checks/run-smoke-tests.mjs
scripts.audit:all: npm run audit:root && npm run audit:server && npm run audit:functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:bim && npm run typecheck:strict:server-profile-feed && tsc -p ./tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:demo && tsc -p ./tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./tsconfig.functions.json --noEmit
